faq.q: What is the origin of Abdulsamad?
faq.a: Abdulsamad is associated with Arabic. Abdulsamad is Arabic عَبْدُ الصَّمَد (ʿAbd al-Ṣamad), meaning 'servant of the Eternal'.
Yes — the underlying form عَبْدُ الصَّمَد is Arabic.
Abdulsamad can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Abdulsamad should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. ʿAbd al-Ṣamad is a compound of two Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Abdulsamad mean in Persian?
